### Isaac Marries Rebekah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/isaac-marries-rebekah
Passage: Genesis 24:62-67
Points:
- Isaac steps forward to succeed Abraham as patriarch, establishing Rebekah as the covenant community's new matriarch.
- The Lord faithfully guides and prospers those who diligently fulfill their covenant responsibilities.
- Important life choices, including marriage, should focus on advancing God's kingdom rather than mere personal gratification.
- Believers must seek God through intentional seasons of solitary prayer and meditation if they desire His guidance.
